observations: Photo 0: Closed Dell laptop with plastic wrap, showing the lid with the Dell logo. The laptop appears to be dark gray or black. The background shows a store shelf with tech products.

Photo 1: Bottom of the laptop, also wrapped in plastic. A Dell Base Warranty sticker is visible with service tag, order number, and manufacturing date (07-07-2014). The laptop has ventilation grills and ports.

Photo 2: Laptop partially open, showing the keyboard and screen. The screen is off, and the keyboard is backlit. The plastic wrap is still on the edges. The background shows more tech products in a display case.
All photos show the same laptop from different angles, held by a hand. The lighting is dim with purple/blue tones, likely from store lighting.

read_from: photo 1 bottom: Dell Base Warranty sticker

claims.claim: Perfect laptop for all computer related tasks.
claims.evidence: No performance data, no screen test, no boot-up video. The laptop is wrapped and not shown in use. The claim cannot be verified from photos alone.

risks.risk: Laptop may not power on or have functional hardware (screen, keyboard, battery, ports).
risks.proof: Video of the laptop turning on, showing the BIOS or OS, and demonstrating keyboard and touchpad functionality.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or non-functional.

risks.risk: The laptop may have physical damage not visible in photos (e.g., cracked screen, broken hinges, internal damage).
risks.proof: Close-up video of the screen turning on and showing no dead pixels or cracks, and a full view of the hinges and keyboard under use.
risks.if_unproven: Priced with a discount for potential hidden damage.

risks.risk: The manufacturing date is 2014 (from photo 1 sticker), which may indicate an outdated model with obsolete hardware.
risks.proof: Photo of the service tag or system information screen showing the exact model and specs (CPU, RAM, storage).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a very old model, likely low-end or obsolete.

proof_requests: Video of the laptop turning on and showing the BIOS or operating system.
Photo or video of the service tag or system information screen to confirm model and specs.
Close-up video of the screen and keyboard in use, showing no damage or defects.
response.reason: The laptop is identifiable as a Dell, but the model and specs are unknown. The seller's claim of 'perfect for all tasks' is unverifiable. The manufacturing date suggests it is old, and there is no proof of functionality. Without proof of working condition and model details, a price cannot be confidently assigned.
